# Markpost

> Markpost catches inbound webhooks and email, converts them to clean Markdown with YAML frontmatter (title, tags, source, timestamps), and its CLI syncs them straight into your local Obsidian vault.

Base URL: https://dh-markpost.netlify.app. The HTTP API lives under `/api` and authenticates with a bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer mp_live_...`), minted from Settings or `POST /api/tokens`. Public ingest endpoints (`/api/hooks/{slug}`) authenticate with a per-source signature instead.

Content pages also serve a Markdown representation via content negotiation: request them with `Accept: text/markdown` (or append `.md`).

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://dh-markpost.netlify.app/docs): quickstart, core concepts, authentication, webhooks, email-in, records API, CLI reference, and Markdown/frontmatter.
- [Pricing](https://dh-markpost.netlify.app/pricing): Hobby ($0) and Pro plans.
- [Home](https://dh-markpost.netlify.app/): product overview.

## API & machine-readable resources

- [OpenAPI specification](https://dh-markpost.netlify.app/openapi.json): the full HTTP API surface (OpenAPI 3.1).
- [Protected-resource metadata](https://dh-markpost.netlify.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 metadata declaring the API's supported OAuth scopes.
- [Sitemap](https://dh-markpost.netlify.app/sitemap.xml): all public URLs.

## Markdown representations

- [Documentation (Markdown)](https://dh-markpost.netlify.app/docs.md)
- [Pricing (Markdown)](https://dh-markpost.netlify.app/pricing.md)

The home page's Markdown is served from the root URL when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`.
